$$
λ(3a - b)=λ(3)a+λ(-1)b.
$$

$$

$$
λ=8

$$
λ(\frac{1}{2}a + 3b)=λ(\frac{1}{2})a+λ(3)b.
$$

The same scale factor must multiply the whole non-zero vector. Comparing the two coefficients gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
λ &= \frac{-1}{\frac{1}{2}} = -2 \\
λ &= \frac{-6}{3} = -2
\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that

$$
-a - 6b=-2(\frac{1}{2}a + 3b).
$$

Therefore,

$$
λ=-2
